findings.title: Bot stays mostly flat
findings.what: No blocked trade type shows an edge after fees. Staying flat is right until one does.

findings.title: Grader saw only 4h of a 12h window
findings.what: Blocked-signal grading fixed; ledger now logs R correctly plus stops and targets.

findings.title: Confidence floors pick better trades
findings.what: On 176 real trades a higher floor only means fewer trades; shuffled confidence did as well. No change.

findings.title: Crowded longs: stops hit a bit more often
findings.what: On days when a coin's funding is in the top 20% (strictly above the cut), a normal stop is hit ~2.7 pts more often (t=3.0, 1,010 days). Live flag now matches what was tested. Size down a little.

findings.title: Safe leverage was ~15% too generous
findings.what: It came from too few bad days to see the true worst ones. The terminal now shows the corrected, safer number.

findings.title: Bot-down alerts reach your phone
findings.what: In September a 3-day crash was detected but nobody saw it. Now 'bot down' or 'AI degraded' goes to your Telegram Saved Messages.

findings.title: Laptop crunches data on its own, hourly
findings.what: No Claude needed: archives every coin's candles, funding and open interest (830k bars, 169 coins) and keeps the tests' counts current.

findings.title: Don't chase small-cap breakouts (in history; forward test running)
findings.what: Corrected on 164 coins: a small cap breaking its 20-day high tends to FALL vs peers over 1-7 days (8%+ above: about -15% in 3 days). Avoid longs there. Shorting it is not proven.

findings.title: Counter-trend entries lose more (RETRACTED)
findings.what: Retracted 10-12: momentum had been measured at the trade CLOSE, so it contained the outcome. Measured at the real entry, the win-rate gap is gone.

findings.title: Syndicate moonbags: can't tell yet
findings.what: 200 calls, 31 days: most lose about half; whether keeping a slice beats selling all is unanswerable until ~3x more calls. Missing-price calls (likely rugs) flip the sign.

findings.title: Picking Syndicate winners at call time
findings.what: 300 calls, 17 call-time stats, prereg + holdout: nothing picks the 1.5x runners. Small/thin coins die more (70% vs 35%) but win as often. Top 5% of calls = 60% of upside.

findings.title: Buying every meme call, any exit rule
findings.what: 413 corrected calls, before fees: every exit target (1.5x/2x/3x) lands at about -9 to -11% per call at 24h, 7d and 14d (statistically clear at all three); holding about -45%; ~1 in 5 coins dies. The target is not the lever - the assets are. 10x runners real but rare.
